fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS • Potential for Genotoxicity and Carcinogenicity. ( 5.1 ) • Embryo-Fetal Toxicity: May cause fetal harm. Pregnancy testing is recommended for females of reproductive potential. Advise females of reproductive potential of the potential risk to a fetus and to use effective contraception.…

summary: Official warnings state that Nifurtimox has the potential to cause genetic damage and cancer, and it may also harm an unborn baby [4]. Because of this risk of fetal harm, pregnancy testing is recommended for females who can have children, and they are advised to use effective birth control [4]. Additionally, a small computer model—rather than tests on people—rated the drug's liver risk as high and its heart risk as low [M]. Meanwhile, a similar medicine called Dantrolene has a strong boxed warning in the United States for liver injury [3].
